releaseNotes:
﻿## Home Assistant
- Local LAN arrivals API (timestamps only, no guest names) for Home Assistant REST sensors
- Settings → Connections → Home Assistant: generate, rotate, or revoke the API token
- Docs: docs/homeassistant.md (REST sensor + sunset/sunrise light automation examples)

## Monthly calendar
- Inquiries can be dragged between days and rooms (including from the waiting list onto a room)
- Inquiries may overlap occupied rooms without blocking the move

## Conferences / participants
- Room-capacity errors now show a clear message (room, beds, occupants) instead of a silent URL
- Unassigned conference overnight guests no longer consume beds until assigned a sleeping room
